text:
ITEM 1 | Bowl of white ceramic, about 20-22 cm across, used as reference; greens and meat fill most of it. Dark leafy greens (mixed lettuce/spinach-like leaves, bright green to dark olive) covering roughly 50% of the bowl, flat and limp with slight moisture, some torn edges | 110
ITEM 2 | Sliced cooked meat, reddish-brown to pink interior with browned outer crust, several strips about 5-7 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, slightly glossy and moist, sitting on top of greens, one large piece in lower left and a cluster on right | 150
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets, about 2-3 cm across each, firm, slightly glossy, scattered among the greens (about 6-8 florets) | 60
ITEM 4 | Dark brown to black mushroom-like pieces, irregular shape about 2-3 cm, soft and slightly glossy, a few scattered near top and right edge | 15
ITEM 5 | Thin pale white-green shreds, fine and wispy, a small tuft near bottom right under the leaves | 5
